open.fact: DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-62227-6 does not state a thermal expansion in the text opened for 068 and reused here. The magnitude 1.0e-6 per K is the Mateck HOPG in-plane catalogue value, a different product. The negative sign was not credited in the additive self-stress terms.

Version 7's thermal interface, cure and core-wall terms stay on 12.3e-6. They do not take the face expansion. The interface margin therefore stays near 1.07. A graphite-to-core mismatch was not substituted.

No compressive strength of the mirror film was opened. The tensile mean 1.29 GPa and the programme 379.2 MPa give the same payloads, so that range does not bind. A strength below 379.2 MPa was not run.

The optima sit at Vc 3.02 to 3.45. The CR-1457 support for gamma 0.20 is the named limit below Vc 2. Holding 0.20 there is what the card asks. Version 7's handbook step sets gamma to 1 above Vc 2, and that run is separate.

The ten percent adhesive thickness, zero adhesive modulus and 1200 kg/m3 adhesive density are a projection. The dogbone thickness was not separated from the process gauges of about 2, 25 and 145 micrometres.
